stemMd: A process rejects 4% of all items produced. To obtain at least 1200 accepted items, assuming this exact rate applies, what is the minimum number of items that must be produced?
explanationMd: Accepted items are 96% of production. Solve 0.96N=1200 to obtain N=1250. Four percent of 1250 is 50, leaving exactly 1200 accepted.

distractorRationale.a: This applies the acceptance rate in the wrong direction.
distractorRationale.c: This adds 4% to the target rather than dividing by the acceptance fraction.
